description: This file contains data access helper functions for interacting with a Supabase backend, specifically for fetching transaction data, summaries, recent activity, insights, and alerts in a financial dashboard application. It includes utility functions for data normalization, date range building, and currency conversion, and exports multiple functions for retrieving various datasets with filtering and pagination support.

methods.name: toNumberOrNull
methods.description: Normalizes a value to a finite number or null.

methods.name: normalizeCurrency
methods.description: Normalizes a currency code to a 3-letter uppercase string, defaulting to 'USD'.

methods.name: escapeForILike
methods.description: Escapes special characters for SQL ILIKE search.

methods.name: buildOccurredAtBounds
methods.description: Builds ISO date range bounds from local date inputs.

methods.name: getMonthBounds
methods.description: Returns the start and end ISO strings for the current month.

methods.name: sumAmounts
methods.description: Sums amounts from rows, handling string or numeric values.

methods.name: sumAmountsUSD
methods.description: Converts and sums amounts in USD from rows, using provided rates.

methods.name: deriveTrendPercent
methods.description: Estimates a UI trend percentage based on a value.

methods.name: getUserContext
methods.description: Returns user context with userId and demo flag, defaulting to a demo UUID if none provided.

methods.name: requireSupabase
methods.description: Ensures the supabase client is configured, throws error if not.

methods.name: getRatesForConversion
methods.description: Fetches FX rates, relies on internal caching.

methods.name: fetchDashboardSummaryFromSupabase
methods.description: Fetches current month transaction summary, normalized to USD, including spend, budget, and savings.

methods.name: fetchRecentTransactionsFromSupabase
methods.description: Retrieves recent transactions with USD normalization and related info.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsPageFromSupabase
methods.description: Fetches paginated transactions with filters for date, category, amount, and search.

methods.name: fetchTransactionsSummaryFromSupabase
methods.description: Provides a summary (total, average) of transactions based on filters.

methods.name: fetchInsightsSummaryFromSupabase
methods.description: Fetches a lightweight insights summary for a given time range and segment.

methods.name: fetchAlertsFromSupabase
methods.description: Retrieves alerts with optional status and severity filters.
